text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still, there are so many challenges ahead. 
Rice has to try even harder...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon! Miss Bourbon!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Is there something I can help you with?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Chestnut Super Express! 
You gave us another glimpse of that 
brilliance in this race!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is looking forward to it! To the 
moment Bourbon-san shines as a Triple 
Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support. Until next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-wait! Just one at least! Please, 
just let me ask one more question!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
To cut right to the chase... after all 
this, who is Bourbon-san's ultimate 
rival!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Archrival...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I deem such an existence unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to taking 1st place, it 
matters not who the opponent is.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Having both confidence and strength. 
Carving out your own path..."
choice_data_list: I've got to work hard too, just like Rice
I need to do my best too, just like Rice

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon is... constantly moving 
forward. If I want to catch up... I can't 
afford to stand still.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Rice wants to catch up to Bourbon-san, 
after all.

"The Classic races on the Triple Crown 
route are three: the Satsuki Sho, the 
Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho."

The upcoming Satsuki Sho is 2000m on turf. 
If Rice Shower, a stayer, wants to 
compete, she needs just a little more 
distance.

The one who seems likely to get the first 
chance is—
choice_data_list:
First, let's compete in the Japanese 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, got it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So Rice followed Bourbon-san... and caught 
up to her...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Without fail...!

And together with Rice Shower, we began 
our preparations for the Japanese Derby.
